envelope.description: Route controller code reviews through admitted continuations

body.title: Route controller code reviews through admitted continuations
body.summary: Update actual code-review MCP registration, input/state schemas and full/degraded handler paths. Acquire explicit controller-reserved declarations, measure the entire response frame, and use atomic versioned pending-call continuations and shared pipeline splitting rather than unbudgeted four-prompt bundles.
acceptanceChecks: src/mcp/server.ts and daemon types register the new declaration/envelope contract; missing, malformed, stale or unqualified controller input refuses before prompt exposure.
Full and degraded responses include every prompt/schema/grounding/framing component in admission; four individually fitting prompts whose combined frame exceeds the cap split or explicitly refuse.

One pending admitted call per turn carries correct IDs/material; no unmeasured whole grounding is appended. Matching replies advance state atomically and all dimensions/obligations complete before final persistence.
Controller host context remains caller-declared/reserved, never server-measured; caller cannot increase the pinned cap and must refresh host reserve before each next emission.
Initial/resume/confirm_wait/judgements, old-token/replay, concurrent-finalization, error recovery and chunk-scaled deadline cases are covered without weakening other-party or source/lifecycle checks.

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/__tests__/handler.test.ts: full degraded and confirm-wait controller continuations use complete-frame admission and atomic call consumption
src/mcp/__tests__/review-budget-schema.test.ts: registered code-review declaration envelope and schema lookup match runtime contracts
